---
name: guard
host_source:
  - https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions
  - https://developers.openai.com/codex/rules
host_claude_deny:
  - "Edit(**/sample-settings.json)"
  - "Read(**/sample_snapshots/**)"
  - "Glob(**/sample_snapshots/**)"
  - "Grep(**/sample_snapshots/**)"
  - "Write(**/sample-settings.json)"
  - "Bash(taskkill *claude*)"
  - "Bash(taskkill *codex*)"
  - "Bash(pskill *claude*)"
  - "Bash(pskill *codex*)"
  - "Bash(Stop-Process *claude*)"
  - "Bash(Stop-Process *codex*)"
  - "PowerShell(Stop-Process *claude*)"
  - "PowerShell(Stop-Process *codex*)"
  - "PowerShell(taskkill *claude*)"
  - "PowerShell(taskkill *codex*)"
  - "Bash(git reset --hard*)"
  - "Bash(git clean*)"
  - "Bash(git push --force*)"
  - "Bash(git push -f*)"
  - "Bash(git push * --force*)"
  - "Bash(git push * -f*)"
  - "Bash(git add -A*)"
  - "Bash(git add --all*)"
  - "Bash(git commit -a*)"
  - "Bash(git commit --all*)"
  - "Bash(git -C * add -A*)"
  - "Bash(git -C * add --all*)"
  - "Bash(git -C * commit -a*)"
  - "Bash(git -C * commit --all*)"
  - "Read(**/.env*)"
  - "Read(**/.sample-project_secrets/**)"
  - "Edit(**/.sample-project_secrets/**)"
  - "Write(**/.sample-project_secrets/**)"
  - "Read(**/.sample-project-secrets/**)"
  - "Edit(**/.sample-project-secrets/**)"
  - "Write(**/.sample-project-secrets/**)"
  - "Read(**/*.pfx)"
  - "Read(**/*.p12)"
  - "Read(**/*.pem)"
  - "Read(**/id_rsa*)"
  - "Edit(**/.env*)"
  - "Write(**/.env*)"
  - "Bash(*<<*\\*)"
host_codex_rules:
  - "taskkill"
  - "pskill"
  - "Stop-Process"
  - "git reset --hard"
  - "git clean"
  - "git push --force|-f|--force-with-lease"
  - "git add -A|--all|."
  - "git commit -a|--all"
  - "git checkout|restore --"
  - "cat|type|Get-Content|more|less|head|tail .env|.env.local|.env.production|sample-settings.json"
---
Migration fixture; preserves exact legacy restrictions.
